I understand it can be frustrating when tracking information isn't available yet. Here's what's likely happening:
When you place an order, it may take a few days before tracking information becomes available. Your order might still be in "unfulfilled" status, meaning it hasn't yet been picked up for production or carrier pickup.
Once your order ships, you'll receive a shipping confirmation email with your tracking number and carrier information. Even after that email arrives, the tracking may show "Label Created" or "Awaiting Carrier Pickup" for a few days before the first scan occurs.
If tracking shows no movement for more than 10 business days, or if the estimated delivery date has passed without updates, I'd recommend reaching out to our support team so they can investigate and help.
